findings.title: Findings converge on D4's single treatment of unknown v1 booking statuses
findings.recommended: B: Keep D4's rule and address Findings 3 and 4 individually
findings.choice_reason: Live v1 data showed date fields track status on 49 of 49 records; D4 moved to the date-derived rule

findings.title: D6's parser has no defined bounds, and the decision block still describes a different choice
findings.recommended: B: Keep the parser and pin it
findings.chosen: B: Keep the parser and pin it

findings.title: D4 drops the local overlap check for unknown statuses on the strength of a server check nobody has seen on v1
findings.recommended: C: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: Cancel-flavored unknown statuses appear as live bookings in default get_bookings results
findings.recommended: C: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: D1 doesn't say whether the normalizer matches exactly, so == and ClassFilter can disagree
findings.recommended: A: Specify exact matching in D1, and narrow the posture sentence to exact-match values
findings.chosen: A: Specify exact matching in D1, and narrow the posture sentence to exact-match values

findings.title: A ClassFilter typo becomes an empty result, and the warning repeats on every construction
findings.recommended: A: Keep D2 as ratified, with a WARNING on each construction
findings.chosen: A: Keep D2 as ratified, with a WARNING on each construction

findings.title: The docs should say to compare by value, because isinstance results change between releases
findings.chosen: Docs say to narrow with isinstance before .value and compare by value rather than by type

findings.title: The warn-once set has an unbounded key space and logs a server-controlled value
findings.recommended: C: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: C: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: The published OpenAPI anyOf loses enum precision for code generators, and the release note doesn't mention it
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: A: Mention the anyOf schema change in the feat! body
